customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of good quality and appreciate its appearance, describing it as beautiful and premium-looking. Moreover, the installation process receives positive feedback, with one customer noting seamless integration through the app, and the functionality works as advertised with all features properly functioning. Customers find it easy to use and appreciate its strong security features, with one mentioning it comes with four different modes of opening. However, opinions on value for money are mixed, with some finding it worth the investment while others advise against purchasing it.
